title: The Inexperienced Spy private-hand TagDuel adapter

cards.name: The Inexperienced Spy
cards.officialText: Select and see 1 card in your opponent's hand.

behavior.selection: The activating seat chooses one of the two opposing physical seats and one UID from that seat's private hand.
behavior.privacy: Only the exact activating seat receives the card identity. Its teammate and both opponents receive no private payload.
behavior.persistence: The reveal receipt is transient and non-enumerable; it is not stored in TagDuel state or the public duel log.
behavior.movement: The selected card stays in its owner's hand; The Inexperienced Spy goes to the shared Graveyard.
behavior.timing: Main Phase of the active seat; negation produces no reveal; duplicate activation receipts are idempotent.

invariants.handLimitCheck: End Phase; adapter does not discard

covered: only activating physical seat receives card identity
both opposing physical hands, including inactive partner
selected card remains in the selected hand
set source owned by inactive teammate
non-enumerable private receipt and public view
3+3 zones, Main Deck 20-30 and Extra Deck 5
public TagDuel projection does not expose the selected hand card identity
